title: Associator for iterated total tensor complexes
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ be a commutative $R$-algebra, let $P_E$ and $P_K$ be cochain complexes of $A$-modules, and let $Q$ be a cochain complex of $R$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. The canonical rebracketing map of total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] $$\operatorname{Tot}((P_E \otimes_A P_K) \otimes_R Q) \longrightarrow \operatorname{Tot}(P_E \otimes_A (P_K \otimes_R Q))$$, with the induced $A$-module structure through $P_E$, is a natural chain isomorphism in $P_E$, $P_K$, and $Q$.
